pointers.Original Text: （うん。崇とファンの子たちみたい）

(Yeah. Like Takashi and the fan
kids.)
pointers.MT Text:
(Yeah. Like Takashi and the fan
kids.)

pointers.Original Text: （あの、すごく今更なんですけどこれって覗き見じゃないですか？　自分はモリ先輩に来るなって言われてたのに……）
pointers.New Text:
(Excuse me, but isn't this kind
of like peeping? I was told not
to come here by Mori-senpai...)
pointers.MT Text:
(Excuse me, but isn't this kind
of like peeping? I was told not
to come here by Mori-senpai...)

pointers.Original Text: （んーとね、ハルちゃんに黙っててごめんなさいなんだけど、崇はハルちゃんに来てもらいたかったんだよ？）

(I'm sorry for keeping it from
you, Haru-chan, but Takashi
wanted to see you?)
pointers.MT Text:
(I'm sorry for keeping it from
you, Haru-chan, but Takashi
wanted to see you?)

pointers.Original Text: （うん。えっとね、さっきの崇が心配かどうかって質問でハルちゃんがうん、って言ってくれたらね）
pointers.New Text:
(Okay. Well, if Haru-chan
answers yes to my question about
whether Takashi is okay...)
pointers.MT Text:
(Okay. Well, if Haru-chan
answers yes to my question about
whether Takashi is okay...)

pointers.Original Text: （一緒に行くって崇に事前に言ってあるんだ）

(Told Takashi in advance we'd go
together.)
pointers.MT Text:
(Told Takashi in advance we'd go
together.)

pointers.Original Text: （あの流れって計算されてたんですか！？）
pointers.New Text:
(Was that all part of your
plan!?)

pointers.Original Text: （うん、だからごめんね。ハルちゃん）

(I see... That's why I'm sorry,
Haru-chan.) It
pointers.MT Text:
(I see... That's why I'm sorry,
Haru-chan.) It

pointers.Original Text: 鏡夜先輩を見ているようです、ハニー先輩……。

pointers.Original Text: 「モリくん、突然のお呼び出しに応じて下さってありがとうございます。」
pointers.New Text:
Thank you for coming on such
short notice, Mori-kun.
pointers.MT Text:
Morikun, thanks for coming on such
short notice.

pointers.Original Text: 「私たち、モリくんに謝りたくて……。他の子たちも謝りたいっておっしゃっていたのだけれど」
pointers.New Text:
We wanted to apologize to
Mori-kun... The others said they
wanted to apologize too.
pointers.MT Text:
We wanted to apologize to
Mori-kun... The others said they
wanted to apologize too.

pointers.Original Text: 「あまり多くの人間ですとまとまりにも欠けますし。代表として私とこの子とでお呼び致しましたの」
pointers.New Text:
Too many people would be unruly,
so we called just myself and
this girl as representatives.
pointers.MT Text:
There wouldn't be much order with
too many people, so I just invited
myself and this kid to represent.

pointers.Original Text: 「……謝るのは俺の方であって、君たちに否はない」
pointers.New Text:
I'm the one who should be
apologizing, not you guys.
pointers.MT Text:
...It's me who should be
apologizing, not you guys.

pointers.Original Text: 「いえ！　私たち、知っていましたの。モリくんが眠い状態ですとどのような状態になるのか」
pointers.New Text:
No! We knew that Mori-kun would
be like this when he's sleepy.
pointers.MT Text:
No! We knew that Mori-kun would
be like this when he's sleepy.

pointers.Original Text: （モリ先輩のこと、よく知っているみたいですね）
pointers.New Text:
(You seem to know a lot about
Morisenpai.)
pointers.MT Text:
(You seem to know a lot about
Morisenpai.)

pointers.Original Text: （そうだね。崇のファンだもん、知っててもおかしくないよね。僕、うっかりしてたよ）
pointers.New Text:
(I see. Since you're Takashi's
fan, it wouldn't be strange for
you to know. I was careless.)
pointers.MT Text:
(I see. Since you're Takashi's
fan, it wouldn't be strange for
you to know. I was careless.)

pointers.Original Text: （いえ、自分もそのことに気が付きませんでしたからお相子ですよ）
pointers.New Text:
(I didn't notice either, so I'm
just like you.)
pointers.MT Text:
(I didn't notice either, so I'm
just like you.)

pointers.Original Text: 「ですが、甘い言葉を囁かれつい舞い上がってしまったのです。モリくんが困ると知っていながら、私たち……」
pointers.New Text:
Your sweet words got to us. We
knew it'd bother you,
Mori-kun...
pointers.MT Text:
Your sweet words got to us. We
knew it'd bother you,
Mori-kun...

pointers.Original Text: 「本当にごめんなさい。お詫びの品としてモリくんの机にプレゼントを置いておきました」
pointers.New Text:
I'm really sorry. I left a
present on Mori-kun's desk as an
apology.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm really sorry. I left a
present on Mori-kun's desk as an
apology.

pointers.Original Text: 「私たち、ずっと謝りたかったんです。直接お渡しするには量が多かったので、持参せずに机に置いてきてしまいましたが……」
pointers.New Text:
We've wanted to apologize for so
long. Too much to carry, so we
left it on your desk...
pointers.MT Text:
We've wanted to apologize.
There was too much to carry,
so we left some on your desk.

......That's enough for me to hear
that

pointers.Original Text: 「眠い状態で出てしまったのは俺の落ち度だ。だから謝らなくていい」
pointers.New Text:
It's my fault for leaving while
sleepy. So you don't have to
apologize.
pointers.MT Text:
It's my fault for falling asleep and
leaving like that, so you don't have
to apologize.

pointers.Original Text: 「いいえ！　私たちが悪いのです！　ですからモリくんは謝らないで下さい！！」
pointers.New Text:
No! It's our fault! So don't
apologize, Mori-kun!!
pointers.MT Text:
No! It's our fault! So don't
apologize, Mori-kun!!

pointers.Original Text: 「いや。どんな事情であれ、俺の不摂生からおきた事件だ」
pointers.New Text:
No. No matter what happened,
this incident started because of
my carelessness.
pointers.MT Text:
No way. No matter what happened,
this is my fault for being careless.

pointers.Original Text: 「いいえ、舞い上がってしまった私たちが……」
pointers.New Text:
No, it's us who got carried
away...
pointers.MT Text:
No, it's us who got carried
away...

pointers.Original Text: 平行線が続く中、それに終止符を打つようにモリ先輩の手が差し出される。

As the parallel lines continue,
Mori-senpai's hand steps in to
put an end to it.

As the parallel lines continued on,
Mori-senpai's hand stepped in to put

pointers.MT Text: Then... can I get a handshake?

The girls take the offered
hands.

The girls take the offered
hands.

pointers.Original Text: 無事誤解も解けて、彼女たちはまたモリ先輩のいるホスト部に通ってくるだろう。

Now that everything's cleared
up, they'll come back to the
Host Club with Mori-senpai.
pointers.MT Text:
Now that everything's cleared
up, they'll come back to the
Host Club with Mori-senpai.

pointers.Original Text: それが自分のことのように嬉しかった。

I was happy for them as if it
were me.

I was happy for them as if it were
my own thing.

(Takashi and those kids were
great too.)
pointers.MT Text:

Takashi, you did well.

Chong, you did great. Usachan's

I grasp Mori-senpai's thin hand.

I grasp Mori-senpai's thin hand.

Please take care of me in the
